metadata.title: TechToJob | Tech community and opportunities
metadata.description: Where developers and companies meet by building real projects.

hero.title: The job you want is not on a job board
hero.description: On a job board you send your CV and disappear among automated rejections. At TechToJob you build real projects, join tournaments and let companies see you work before a role opens.
hero.messageNote: Saw your Pull Request in the challenge
hero.message: We loved how you structured the state. Shall we talk tomorrow?
hero.caption: Take off without middlemen

howItWorks.title: From joining the chat to your next opportunity
howItWorks.description: No endless forms or weeks waiting for an answer that never comes.

steps.title: Join Discord
steps.description: Introduce yourself, pick your stack channels and see what is being built today.

steps.title: Build in public
steps.description: Join tournaments, help others and share real code as you work.

steps.title: Get known in action
steps.description: Developers and technical leaders see how you solve problems before a role exists.

steps.title: Get contacted directly
steps.description: No middlemen or automated filters rejecting you for lacking years of experience.

talent.title: Publish your profile and let real people read it
talent.description: A static list of keywords does not show your judgment. TechToJob lets you show working solutions and the thinking behind your decisions.
points: You do not need to be senior

companies.title: See how people work before deciding who to hire
companies.description: A resume says what someone claims to know. Watching a developer ship a challenge or debate architecture shows how they really think.
companies.traditionalText: Download hundreds of PDFs, read identical tool lists and run preliminary interviews to find out whether they can actually code.
companies.approachText: See code in repositories, examine real technical debates and talk to people without barriers.

tournaments.title: Technical tournaments: learn, prove yourself and leave a mark
tournaments.description: What you build does not sit in a drawer: it strengthens your portfolio and can become part of active projects.

networking.title: The best roles are not posted: you hear about them
networking.description: Great hires often happen because someone on the team shares an opening in a channel.

news.title: Project news and pulse
items: The community web design challenge concludes

newsletter.title: Technical news and opportunities every week
newsletter.description: Every Monday: new opportunities, tournaments and technical resources. One email a week, no spam.
newsletter.success: Done! You are on the Monday list.

footer.description: The community where developers and companies meet by building.
